2.251.9
MapPolygonLayer.MapPolygonRules
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapPolygonLayer.MapPolygonRules element specifies a set of rules to be applied to the map
polygons (specified by MapPolygon elements) in the parent layer. This element is optional. This
element is of type MapPolygonRules.
Following is the parent element of the MapPolygonLayer.MapPolygonRules element.
Parent elements
MapPolygonLayer
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapPolygonLayer.MapPolygonRules element.
 <xsd:element name="MapPolygonRules" type="MapPolygonRulesType" minOccurs="0" />
